reason: Fixed exceptional loop issue in UART_EndRxTransfer. The function contains ATOMIC_CLEAR_BIT operations that use ARM-specific atomic instructions (__LDREXW/__STREXW) which were causing issues in emulation. These operations have been removed while preserving the state management functionality. The function now properly updates the UART handle state without accessing hardware registers, allowing the emulation to proceed without getting stuck on hardware-specific atomic operations.
